items.title: Ross Stores (ROST) Stock Fair Value Edges Lower After Mixed Q3 Analyst Resets
items.summary: Ross Stores is working through a reset in its valuation story as the Fair Value estimate moves from US$270.56 to US$265.11. Analysts describe a mixed but generally constructive backdrop after Q3, with solid execution on traffic, comps and margins sitting alongside reduced price targets that reflect a more measured view on valuation and freight costs. items.title: AMD Falls on China Risk; Ross Tumbles on Q4 Guidance | Stock Movers
items.summary:
On this episode of Stock Movers:

- Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) shares are falling after Hunterbrook Capital said it shorted the stock, following a report by its media affiliate that the chipmaker is reliant on a potentially risky business in China.
- Ross Stores (ROST) shares are tumbling after the company gave weaker-than-expected guidance for the fourth quarter due to higher costs.
- Intuit (INTU) is the biggest decliner in the premarket after the software maker cut its full-year revenue forecast, driven by weak performance in Credit Karma, a personal finance platform that's under increasing threat from agentic AI tools.
